title: nautilus scene document
description: A 3D process view as data — the spatial sibling of a *.mimic.json P&ID: nodes placed in space, pipes run between them, live tag bindings. Rendered by @joyautomation/nautilus-hmi-3d's <SceneView>, edited as text, diffed and reviewed like the program it belongs to. Positions are METRES in the site frame (the origin marker at [0, 0, 0], +y up), so the file that drives the desktop view is also the file that will place AR overlays. `naut check` runs the same structural rules as this schema, plus the kind ↔ tag-type contract a schema cannot express. Brief: docs/design/spatial-hmi.md.

kinds.description: The kind ↔ struct-type contract (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3b): overrides for the built-in kinds (tank → Tank, pump → Motor, valve → Valve) and declarations for kinds the app registers itself. Keyed by kind name. `naut check` holds every node of a declared kind to its `type` and `members`.

camera.description: Initial camera. Positions in scene metres.

fixtures.description: Static, unbound geometry: the desk, a floor slab, the origin marker.

grid.description: A reference grid on a horizontal plane.

nodes.description: Equipment placed in the scene, each optionally bound to a live tag.

pipes.description: Polylines run between nodes, optionally showing flow state.

writable.description: Reserved: tags an operator may write from this scene. The view is read-only until the write path ships, so a non-empty list is an error rather than a silent no-op — this list must stay empty.

bindingRef.description: A tag reference: an absolute name or dotted path, read from the frame's tag map (`Demand`, `P101.Speed`; no indexing). A leading `!` negates a boolean prop: the prop is `value !== true`. An absent path leaves the prop unset, so the component's default holds.

type.description: The UDT a node of this kind binds. The built-ins default to tank → Tank, pump → Motor, valve → Valve; re-point one here if the project's UDT is named differently.

members.description: The members the kind's component reads off the struct, so `naut check` can hold every node of this kind to the same standard.

kindContract.description: The UDT ↔ members contract for one kind.

pos.description: Camera position, [x, y, z] metres, site frame.

target.description: Look-at point, [x, y, z] metres, site frame.

fov.description: Vertical field of view, degrees. Default 45.

pos.description: Grid origin, [x, y, z] metres, site frame.

section.description: Heavier line every this many metres. Default 1.

kind.description: Fixture shape: box, plane, or the origin marker.

size.description: box: [w, h, d] metres; plane / marker: [w, d] metres.

id.description: Unique in the document; what a pick reports.

kind.description: Registry key: 'tank' | 'pump' | 'valve' | one the app registered, or one declared under the document's `kinds`.

tag.description: The struct tag this node binds; the kind's component reads its members.

rot.description: Degrees, XYZ order; [0, yaw, 0] turns the node on the spot.

props.description: Static props passed straight through to the component.

bind.description: Live props: component prop -> ref. Same map and rules as a mimic equipment's `bind`, plus dotted paths for struct members (`P101.Speed`).

points.description: Polyline in scene metres, at least two points.

flowing.description: The one live prop a pipe has, the same key the mimic's pipe binds. Booleans as-is; a number is flowing above 2 (%).
